claims: The Artemis II crew is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Orion capsule will land after a 10-day mission.
Recovery teams from the U.S. Navy and NASA will assist the astronauts.
Live coverage is available on NASA+, the NASA app, and NASA's YouTube channel starting around 6:30 p.m. EDT.
The astronauts will be transported by helicopter to the USS John P. Murtha for immediate medical evaluations.
The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed return from the Moon since 1972.
